m: A *brush handle* in one hand, *splashing water* from a bucket in the other: the **servant** scrubs the floor all day.
A *lying man* gets up, puts on his *slanted cap* and laces his **shoes**, and his *footsteps* tread down the road.
*Water drops* swell the river until it laps the *bow* of a girl with *long hair* on the bank: the water **rises**.
*Sprinkles* of sunlight hit the *feathers* of a *sparrow* perched on a *tall stool*: it shines **brilliant**.
A *helping hand* grips a *knife* jammed between *two planks* and **twists** it free.
Heap up *soil*, lay *two planks* on top and rest your *elbow* there to pray: an **altar**.
A *helping hand* and a *right hand* sweep the curtain apart: **push aside**.
*Water drops* fall wherever the *dancer* twirls, and flowers spring up from the **fertile** ground.
With *silk thread* a *person* stitches *two planks* and an *elbow* onto cloth: she is **drawing** in thread.
A *standing person* swings a *halberd* at the trunk to **cut down** the tree.
Squeezed in an *open crate* on cold *soil*, *legs* cramped, he sucks a *candy* to **endure** it.
A *standing person* waits beside the master's *fortune stick*, ready to fetch it: a **servant**.
A *child* climbs the *hillside* at the edge of town and touches the **outer city wall**.
A *cow* is led past the *bird nest* up to the altar as a **sacrifice**.
A *thousand ants* swarm the beast until only a *skeleton* remains: **annihilated**.
*Grass* grows over the *soil* where a *big man* lies, never to see the *sun* again: a **tomb**.
A *sparrow* knocks at your *door* asking for work, and you **hire** it.
Under a *shed* lives a deer with fine *antlers* who never takes a bribe: **honest**.
A *big man* cuts notches with a *knife* in a stick to record the *wheat* he sold: a binding **contract**.
A *helping hand* fits *horns* onto a *door bar*, **piecing together** a strange gate.
His *footsteps* crossed the *goal line* too early; with a heavy *heart* the referee must **punish** the cheat.
A *helping hand* shoots out and **grabs** the thief by the *foot*.
Take a *slanted cap* from the *cabinet* and follow the *footsteps* to **cover** the sleeping child's head.
A *lying man* holds a *towel* while a *standing knife* scrapes the mud off his coat; then he **brushes** it clean.
A *strong arm* twists your *elbow* and pushes your face into the *soil*: you are being **robbed**.
A *woman* finds *antlers* nailed over her bed and wrinkles her nose: she **dislikes** them.
A vine bends like an *elbow*, and from it hangs a fat **melon**.
The *sun* beats down on a *cloaked beggar*; he gives a long *yawn* and sits down to **rest**.
A *sparrow* pecks with its *mouth* like a chisel, cutting a *rice field* pattern into wood: it **carves**.
A *heart* shut behind a closed *gate* all day feels stuffy and **bored**.
A *claw*-like hand lifts the *child*, curled like a *ski*, to drink **milk**.
Two *bullseyes* pierced by one rod, like meat on a kebab: **strung together**.
A *woman* shapes two heaps of wet *soil* into a little **baby** doll.
Tie your money up with *silk thread* and pay, or the teacher's *cane* comes out: **hand in** your fees.
A *big man* in the *archway* waves a *bent knife* and opens his *mouth* to **call** everyone to dinner.
A *sail* glides past a *tombstone* under the *moon*; a *mouth* cheers as a *shell* of treasure comes aboard: we **win**!
*Grass* lines the *road* where a *cart* stops by a pond full of **lotus** flowers.
Through *rain* and *moon*light rides a man in *rawhide* armour who takes whatever he wants: the **tyrant**.
Two *legs* dangle from a *tree* branch as a child stretches for a ripe **peach**.
A *claw* rests gently on the *woman*'s shoulder: all is settled, everything is **suitable**.
A patient on the *sickbed* holds up a *right hand* of skin and bone: so **thin**.
A *helping hand* lays *grass* on poles to make a *tent*, leaving a *mouth* for a door: **put up** a shelter.
A *runner* reads his *fortune stick*, then sets off to **go to** the faraway city.
A *hillock* piled on top of a *mountain*: a towering **high mountain**.
A *scholar* beats a drum and sings for the crowd: **excellent**!
Aboard the *boat*, a *person* and a *bowing man* duck down into the **cabin**.
A *standing person* puts a hand on his *elbow* and strikes a pose: so **handsome** and smart.
Mark the *soil* with a *stop sign*: this is the building **site**.
A *dragon* tries to squeeze under a *shed*: it is far too **huge**.
Drag the *plough* between *two planks* that mark the field: you **plough** the land.
*Gold coins* buy a beast with *horns*, a snapping *mouth* and quick *legs*: its horns are **sharp**.
A *silk thread* runs like a *road* where *trudging feet* tramp between the *wheat*: a **seam** stitched across the field.
My *standing heart* aches as *mother* pulls on her *slanted cap* and walks out after our fight: I **regret** it.
Down the *road* comes a messenger, tapping his *cane* on every door to **invite** guests to the feast.
A *king* in a *teepee* bumps a jade bell with his *elbow*: **ting-a-ling**.
A *standing heart* longs for one *sparrow*, and **only** that one.
A *drop* of metal has chipped off the *axe*, and the woodcutter **blames** his apprentice.
A *roof* over a pot with a single *grass blade* in it: a quiet **residence** where you stay at home.
*Water drops* fall from the *sky* onto a *heart cushion*, each one **adding** to the wet patch.
A *helping hand* grabs a *shovel* and starts to **dig**.
One *mouth* blows on a frozen *nail*, another *mouth* joins in: they **breathe out** warm air.
Behind the *curtains*, two lawyers jab with an *elbow* and fire *small speech bubbles* at each other: a **lawsuit**.
*Steam* puffs from a *sheep*'s nose on a cold day: it is breathing **oxygen**.
*Water drops* stretch to the horizon; a *cow head* opens its *mouth* in awe: the lake is **vast**.
Two *single wings* side by side, each lined with soft **feathers**.
Under a *leaning cliff*, a trader drops rice through a *trapdoor* onto the scale: one **catty**, half a kilo.
A *wine jug* is smashed on the *cow head*, and its *mouth* bellows at such a **ruthless** blow.
A *helping hand* sweeps every last *crumb* off the table and runs: **plunder**.
A *woman* turns into a wild *dancer* at midnight, spinning spells: a **witch**.
At the *small altar*, a *person* in the *archway* screams with an open *mouth*: **disaster** has struck.
A *standing person* kneels on the *soil* and holds out tea, *thumb* on the cup: he **serves** his master.
A *swan* curls its neck into the shape of a 2: **second in order**.
A *woman* plants herself in the middle of the *square* and blocks the parade: she **hinders** it.
The *clock* ticks all night while he counts each *shell* again and again: **greedy**.
A *helping hand* wrestles a *bent knife* away from a robber: a hard **struggle**.
*Water drops* rise around the *king*'s castle until it sits in a wide **expanse of water**.
A *lying man* wakes up next to a puddle of *water*: **urine**.
*Grass* and a *grain stalk* grow by the path; a *standing knife* snips a small white flower: **jasmine**.
A *stepladder* is left **hanging** from the ceiling by a rope, swinging over everyone's heads.
A *clam* opens and shuts like a *mouth*: its edges are its **lips**.
Under the *sun*, a scholar marks a *cross*, then another *cross*, with his **writing brush**.
A *person* and a *bowing man* carry sacks of rice into the **barn**.
A *cart* slips off, so we lever it back with a *crowbar* onto the **track**.
A *cane* taps the *tree* and small things drop: a ring, a coin, a badge, each counted one **piece** at a time.
Scrape *soil* off the beach, test it with a *fortune stick*, boil it in a *dish*: white **salt**.
A *watcher* climbs the tower to **view** the whole city.
A *standing person* presses a *thumb* into the *seedbed* to show you how: your **instructor**.
A *towel* tied to a pole waves like a flag above the army's **commander**.
Under a *shed*, people bow before a *pit* full of incense ash: a **temple**.
Part the *curtains* and cut fresh *grass* with a *knife*: the room fills with **fragrance**.
A *lying man* hides behind a folding **screen** made from a *door bar* with *horns* on top.
A monk sweeps the *soil* of the courtyard and counts beads with his *thumb*: a **Buddhist temple**.
Under the *moon*, a beast with *horns* eats all night and grows **fat**.
The *king* finds a *paw print* on his window and frowns at the dirty **glass**.
Under the *archway*, a *heart* follows a *paw print* straight into a trap: how **foolish**.
*Water drops* fall on a *child* in mid-*yawn*: **drip**, drip, right into his open mouth.
Unroll the *cloth roll* to catch the *tumbling baby*, and **clear away** everything in its path.
Only dry *grass* and an old *brush handle* lie in the empty yard: **desolate**.
A *woman* balances on *icicles*, hiding a *yawn* but keeping her elegant **posture**.
Lift the *lid* of the box and a scary *page* flutters out: your hands **tremble**.
A *knife* hacks crooked notches into *two planks*: what an **ugly** fence.
Only a *pinch* of power in that *strong arm*: an **inferior** fighter.
A *nail* is hammered into the *tree*, and a *mouth* shouts as the **branch** snaps off.
A *drop* of ink marks the top joint of your *thumb*: that length is one **inch**.
A *helping hand* balls up an old *ribbon* and **throws** it away.
An *eye* fixed on one *nail*, never blinking: **stare at** it.
A *clam* snaps shut on the boaster's *thumb* in front of everyone: what a **disgrace**.
Two *legs* stick out of one *open crate*, two more from the next: a **matching** pair.
A *standing person* runs an *eye* over the room: **all** are here.
Two *chilies* look the same, but only one burns: taste them to **distinguish** them.
A *side dish* sits out of reach, so a *hand* grabs a *halberd* to spear it: I'm that **hungry**.
A *bug* with *trudging feet* crawls over the *wheat*, buzzing: a **bee**.
A *mouth* gasps as the *hand* drops its *halberd*: **oh**, now I see!
By *moon*light, a *workbench* stands inside a hollow *cave*: a big **cavity**.
A *left hand* waves at the *moon* from a *hillside* thick with **lush** trees.
*Water drops* swell a *tied sack* full of *shell* coins until it **bursts** like a broken dam.
A *small speech bubble* whispers over a *grass basket* full of eggs: be **careful**.
*Rice* left in the *sun* too long goes sour: only the **dregs** remain.
*Grass* creeps in the *sun* and twines round the *cloaked beggar*'s legs: a **kudzu vine**.
*Grass* pokes up in rows across the *rice field*: young **sprouts**.
Under the *moon*, *sun rays* twist and coil like **intestines**.
A *coiled rope* lies near your *heart*: it looks like a snake, and you **fear** it.
While *water drops* hide the noise, a *kneeling man* and another *kneeling man* crawl across the *rice field* and **slip away**.
A big grey bird skims the *water drops* of the lake and honks: a **wild goose**.
A *claw*-like hand lifts the bronze wine cup, given only to men of **noble rank**.
Two *moons* rise as a giant *bird* spreads its wings across them both: the **roc**.
Under a *shed*, a *standing person* holds out a *sparrow* as bait; a big *bird* swoops down: an **eagle**.
A *dragon* trapped behind *bamboo* bars: a **cage**.
An *axe* rests on a *plank* where the ground rises in a small *hillock*: a **mound**.
A *tree* grows on *soil* heaped on more *soil*, and the winner's wreath is cut from it: **laurel**.
*Water drops* feed a stag's *antlers* and two silkworm *cocoons*: they **nourish** them and they grow.
An *ear* leans toward a *kneeling man*, then another *kneeling man*: they **chat** all afternoon.
A *helping hand* holds up a *comb* against the *sprinkles*: it **blocks** them.
The main *silk thread* of the net runs through an *archway*; cut it with *scissors* and all falls apart: the **guiding principle**.
Under the *moon*, a man lifts a *small table* over his head: look at that **muscle**.
*Grass* with spikes like *icicles*: step on it and your *yawn* turns into a yelp. **Caltrop**.
A *scholar* lifts the *cloth cover* off the *small table* and finds only an empty egg **shell**.
From his *sickbed* he gives a *glare* at the mark the wound left: a **scar**.
Under the *roof*, by the *dusk moon*, a *bowing man* sets a *stone* **bowl** of rice on the table.
A *roof* of rock, with *curtains* of vines over the entrance: a **cave**.
Under the *moon*, he flexes an **upper arm** as broad and *square* as a door.
A *little fortune stick* stands on the *sun*, which stands on a *cross*: higher than all, **outstanding**.
He gives away every *shell* he owns to the poor: a **virtuous** person.
The tired *minister* props his *fortune stick* by the bed and **lies down**.
Under the *moon*, the *grass*, the *sun* and a *big man* all look blurry through a thin **membrane**.
On the *podium*, wrapped in a *blanket*, he grips his *war club* and will not back down: **resolute**.
*Gold coins* buy a *towel* woven with a shining *white dove*: rich **brocade**.
A *person* gives a nervous *yawn*: he still **owes** money for that *bent knife*.
A chatty *mouth* in the *village* tacks a **lively ending** onto every sentence.
Drop the letter into the *pit* of the post box, sealed in its **envelope**.
